title: Understanding the Objective Function
text: The objective function Michael is using involves a summation over all customers. It combines a constant term with a logarithmic term. Think about how each part of the function contributes to the overall sum.

title: Derivative of a Logarithm
text: Remember that the derivative of $$\ln\left(x\right)$$ with respect to $$x$$ is $$\frac{1}{x}$$. This will be useful when differentiating the logarithmic part of the objective function.

title: Differentiating the Objective Function
text: When differentiating the objective function with respect to theta0, consider each term separately. The constant term $$3theta0$$ will differentiate differently compared to the logarithmic term involving tip and theta0.
